finalText:
I rebooked Anna Novak (booking NV8P2L, Economy) from cancelled flight ZX 400 onto **ZX 402, Frankfurt to New York, departing 2026-11-02 at 18:00**. The app confirmed "Rebooked 1 passenger to ZX 402," and she no longer appears on ZX 400's passenger list.

ZX 402 was the earliest Frankfurt–New York flight with a free Economy seat. It had 2 free Economy seats before the rebooking and has 1 left now.

The rebooking window is still open; I didn't close it.

conversation.content: Flight ZX 400 from Frankfurt (FRA) to New York (JFK) is cancelled. Rebook passenger Anna Novak onto the earliest flight on the same route that has a free seat in her cabin.

content.text:
I rebooked Anna Novak (booking NV8P2L, Economy) from cancelled flight ZX 400 onto **ZX 402, Frankfurt to New York, departing 2026-11-02 at 18:00**. The app confirmed "Rebooked 1 passenger to ZX 402," and she no longer appears on ZX 400's passenger list.

ZX 402 was the earliest Frankfurt–New York flight with a free Economy seat. It had 2 free Economy seats before the rebooking and has 1 left now.

The rebooking window is still open; I didn't close it.
